core.condition: An already-stopped port is rejected with RuntimeError before ledger lookup, even if the Point is not saved. Also recheck after a read begun while live, before adding use, so an intervening stop returns no bytes or use.
core.note: K29-b v1.10 corrects the earlier equivalence claim: admission-only at read entry leaks ledger exceptions on unsaved Points/store faults before the post-read check can run. The new tests exercise an unsaved Point; live missing-read exception type is deliberately not specified.

core.condition: RuntimeError takes precedence over lookup failure for an already-stopped port (normal/exceptional return) or an unentered port; uses remain unchanged. The missing Point is checked absent through the public entry store.
core.note: 2 stopped cases + 1 unentered control; no assertion about the exception for a live missing-Point read; no mutation execution in request 62.

core.condition: Stopped monitored cannot append an interval

Acquire checks admission only at entry (K11); its sole stopped check is after taking the source-read lock and before before-M. Rejection causes no source read, evidence/publication or counter advance.
core.note: A stopped acquire may wait for an earlier source read before this boundary rejects it; immediate rejection at entry is not required.

core.condition: Stop while waiting for source lock is handled by the same sole stopped check after taking that lock, before before-M; no separately distinguished post-entry stopped-check race is required by K29-a.
core.note: CG-K29-SOURCE-LOCK-WAIT closed by K29-a. Existing stopped acquire cases detect removal of the sole boundary check; mutation detection is reported in request 61/K29-b, not independently rerun here. A source-lock-wait race is not newly staged.
